ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does ʿindii hadiyya mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a gift.
   B. I like the party.
   C. I drink juice.
   D. We dance.

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ج? (1 mark)
   A. qaaf
   B. dhaal
   C. faa
   D. jiim

3. Which sound does the Arabic letter ر make? (1 mark)
   A. a quick rolled r
   B. l as in lamp
   C. b as in bag
   D. th as in think

4. How do you read the syllable تَ? (1 mark)
   A. ta
   B. tu
   C. nu
   D. buu

5. Which Arabic word means "mother's brother"? (1 mark)
   A. خَالٌ
   B. أَخٌ
   C. ابْنٌ
   D. أُخْتٌ

6. Which Arabic sentence asks 'How is the weather today?' (1 mark)
   A. maa ismuka?
   B. ayna l-kitaab?
   C. kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
   D. hal tuhibbu l-mawz?

7. How is the Arabic word بَابٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. baab
   B. taawila
   C. kitaab
   D. saaʿa

8. Which Arabic word means "book"? (1 mark)
   A. سَاعَةٌ
   B. حَقِيبَةٌ
   C. سِكِّينٌ
   D. كِتَابٌ

9. What does the Arabic word مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) mean? (1 mark)
   A. chair
   B. room
   C. lamp
   D. cat

10. How is the Arabic word دَوْرِي read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dawrii
   B. ʿasiir
   C. mabruuk
   D. ʿiid

11. How is the Arabic word شَايٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. dajaaj
   B. tamaatim
   C. shaay
   D. khubz

12. What does the Arabic sentence أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a brother and a sister.
   B. This is my father.
   C. This is my mother.
   D. My mother cooks.

13. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is cold.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is cloudy.
   D. The weather is rainy.

14. Which Arabic word means "mouth"? (1 mark)
   A. رِجْلٌ
   B. يَدٌ
   C. جِسْمٌ
   D. فَمٌ

15. What does the Arabic sentence أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I write with my hand.
   B. I hear with my ear.
   C. I smell with my nose.
   D. I see with my eye.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: ismii Ahmad (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: anaa min Kiiniya (2 marks)

18. Blend the syllables and give the meaning: jad + da + tun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Translate into English: akhii Sagiir (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: aakulu l-aruzza (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: laa talʿab bi-s-sikkiin (2 marks)

22. A four-line poem says: ʿaynii taraa, udhunii tasmaʿu, anfii yashummu, famii yatakallamu. Give the meaning of the first line and say what the poem is about. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — I have a gift.
   ʿindii means I have and hadiyya means gift.

2. D — jiim
   The letter ج is called jiim.

3. A — a quick rolled r
   The letter ر makes the sound a quick rolled r.

4. A — ta
   تَ is read ta.

5. A — خَالٌ
   خَالٌ (khaal) means mother's brother.

6. C — kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm?
   kayfa means how, al-jawwu is the weather and al-yawm is today.

7. A — baab
   بَابٌ is read baab and means door.

8. D — كِتَابٌ
   كِتَابٌ (kitaab) means book.

9. C — lamp
   مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

10. A — dawrii
   دَوْرِي is read dawrii and means my turn.

11. C — shaay
   شَايٌ is read shaay and means tea.

12. D — My mother cooks.
   أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

13. A — The weather is cold.
   الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ (al-jawwu baarid) means: The weather is cold.

14. D — فَمٌ
   فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

15. A — I write with my hand.
   أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: My name is Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am from Kenya.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: jad-da-tun (grandmother). The syllables are read in order and joined.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: My brother is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: I eat rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not play with the knife.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: My eye sees. The poem says what a part of the body does: the eye sees, the ear hears, the nose smells and the mouth speaks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the line and 2 marks for the poem's idea.
